newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Zivno Podilovy to open fund.
newsitem.headline: Czech Zivno Podilovy to open fund.

text.p: Czech investment fund Zivnobanka Podilovy Fund a.s., controlled by Zivnostenska Banka arm ZB-Trust, has decided to convert into an open ended fund, it said in a statement on Thursday.

"The board of investment firm ZB-Trust today has decided to change Zivno Podilovy Fund, which was established during the second coupon privatisation wave, into an open-ended fund," the statement said.
The statement said ZB-Trust hopes to create a family of various open-end funds in the future.
Several Czech closed-end unit trusts similar to Zivno Podilovy have announced their intentions to transform into open-end funds in order to extend investment opportunities.
Zivno Podilovy has issued a total of 1.788 million trust units with a nominal value of 500 crowns.
The statement added that according to preliminary figures, the fund should post a profit of more than 33 million crowns. It did not say whether the figure was net or gross.
